recipes.title: Kirkland Signature Chicken Street Tacos
recipes.description: Costco chicken street taco kit with seasoned chicken, tortillas, slaw, cheese, salsa and cilantro-lime crema
ingredients: Leftover Kirkland Signature Chicken Street Tacos kit, enough for 2
Use the kit’s tortillas, chicken, slaw, cheese, salsa and cilantro-lime crema
steps: Reheat the leftover chicken until steaming hot.
Warm tortillas briefly in a dry skillet or microwave.
Set out the slaw, cheese, salsa and cilantro-lime crema from the kit.
Build tacos with warm chicken and toppings. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Chicken Sausage Rigatoni with Mushrooms & Zucchini
recipes.description: Rigatoni with browned chicken sausage, cremini mushrooms and zucchini in tomato sauce with Parmesan
steps: Bring a pot of well-salted water to a boil. Slice the sausage, zucchini and mushrooms; mince the garlic.
Cook rigatoni until al dente. Reserve ½ cup pasta water, then drain.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Brown sausage 4–5 minutes.
Add mushrooms and zucchini. Cook 5–7 minutes until browned-tender; add garlic for the final 30 seconds.
Add marinara and Italian seasoning. Simmer 3–4 minutes.
Add rigatoni and Parmesan. Toss, adding a splash of pasta water if needed to make the sauce glossy.
Serve hot with extra Parmesan if desired.

recipes.title: Trader Joe’s Mandarin Orange Chicken
recipes.description: Crispy glazed orange chicken over rice with bright green broccoli
ingredients: 1 package Trader Joe’s Mandarin Orange Chicken
steps: Start 1 cup rice according to package directions.
Cook Mandarin Orange Chicken according to package directions, keeping the sauce separate until the chicken is crisp.
While it cooks, heat 1 tsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add broccoli and optional bell pepper.
Cook vegetables 5–7 minutes until crisp-tender. Add 1–2 Tbsp water and cover briefly if you prefer softer broccoli.
Toss the hot chicken with its orange sauce.
Serve chicken over rice with a generous portion of broccoli and peppers.

recipes.title: Argentine-Style Chicken & Chimichurri
recipes.description: Seared chicken with bright chimichurri, charred sweet corn and browned zucchini
ingredients: ½ cup packed fresh parsley, finely chopped
steps: Make chimichurri: combine parsley, garlic, red wine vinegar, 2 Tbsp olive oil, oregano, red pepper flakes and a pinch of salt.
Season chicken with salt and pepper. Heat a large skillet or grill pan over medium-high.
Cook chicken until browned and 165°F in the center, about 5–7 minutes per side depending on thickness. Rest 5 minutes.
While chicken cooks, brush corn and zucchini lightly with the remaining olive oil; season with salt and pepper.
Char corn and zucchini in a hot skillet or grill pan until browned and tender, turning as needed, about 8–10 minutes.
Slice chicken and spoon chimichurri over the top. Serve with charred corn and zucchini.

recipes.title: Turkey Burgers with Tomato-Cucumber Salad & Corn
recipes.description: Juicy seasoned turkey burgers on toasted buns with a crisp tomato-cucumber salad and sweet corn
ingredients: 1 lb ground turkey (form 2 large patties; or make 3 and freeze 1)
¼ small red onion, thinly sliced
1 Tbsp mayonnaise or preferred burger sauce
steps: Dice half the tomato and the cucumber; thinly slice red onion. Toss with 1 tsp olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt and pepper. Slice the remaining tomato for the burgers.
Mix ground turkey gently with Worcestershire, garlic powder, onion powder, ½ tsp salt and pepper. Form two large patties (or three smaller patties and freeze one uncooked).
Heat a skillet or grill pan over medium-high with a light film of oil. Cook patties 5–6 minutes per side until browned and 165°F in the center.
At the same time, cook corn in a hot skillet/grill pan, turning until tender and lightly charred, about 8–10 minutes.
Toast buns cut-side down for 1–2 minutes.
Build burgers with sauce, lettuce if using, sliced tomato and turkey patties. Serve with tomato-cucumber salad and corn.

recipes.title: Chicken & Mushroom Pot Pies
recipes.description: Morgan family chicken pot pies with poached chicken, carrots, leek, cremini mushrooms, corn and a creamy thyme gravy under flaky Pillsbury crust
ingredients: About 2 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts
1 large leek, trimmed, quartered lengthwise and sliced
1 cup Silk Dairy-Free Heavy Whipping Cream
1 tsp minced fresh thyme leaves (or ½ tsp dried thyme)
Kosher salt & freshly ground black pepper
1 large egg, beaten with 1 tsp warm water
steps: Poach chicken gently in simmering water until cooked through, about 15 minutes. Cool slightly, then shred into bite-size pieces; you want about 3 cups.
Heat oven to 400°F. In a wide saucepan over medium heat, cook carrots and leek in 1 Tbsp butter plus olive oil, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 15 minutes. Add garlic near the end.
Add mushrooms and cook, stirring, until tender and their moisture has cooked off, about 8–10 minutes. Transfer the vegetable mixture to a bowl.
Melt the remaining butter in the saucepan. Sprinkle in flour and whisk until smooth; cook a few minutes to remove the raw-flour taste.
Slowly whisk in chicken broth until smooth, then whisk in Silk heavy cream. Simmer until thick and gravy-like.
Return chicken and vegetables to the sauce. Stir in corn and thyme. Season well with salt and black pepper.
Divide filling among 4 oven-safe individual pot-pie dishes or ramekins. Cut refrigerated pie crust to fit each dish with a small overhang.
Lay crust over each pie, crimp the edges, cut a few vents, and brush with egg wash.
Bake at 400°F until the crust is deeply golden and the filling is bubbling, about 25–30 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before serving.
